content.short: Mito is a premier DeFi hub on Injective featuring automated strategy vaults and a decentralized launchpad.
content.description:
Mito is a comprehensive decentralized finance hub built natively on the Injective blockchain, designed to simplify sophisticated trading and yield generation for all users. The platform features an array of automated strategy vaults that execute professional-grade trading techniques, such as market making and trend following, directly on Injective's on-chain order book. This allows participants to earn real yield generated from actual trading activity rather than inflationary token emissions.

In addition to its yield-bearing vaults, Mito includes a decentralized launchpad that enables new projects to conduct token sales and bootstrap liquidity through community-driven governance. Governed by the MITO token, the protocol serves as a central liquidity engine for the Injective ecosystem, providing users with a transparent and non-custodial venue for asset management. Through its focus on user-centric design and high-performance financial tools, Mito is empowering the next generation of DeFi participants to maximize their capital efficiency with ease.
